text:
jamie: Quick sync — smoke tests showed two contract mismatches between SDKs and REST: (1) optional list params are emitted as `null` by py-sdk but REST treats missing vs null differently; (2) param renaming between py (snake_case) and ts (camelCase) isn't consistently normalized on our server. Anyone free to triage? :eyes:

sarah: could you paste an example payload? I want to repro locally.

jamie: repro from e2e: Python SDK sent `stop_sequences: None` -> server interpreted as explicit null and returned 400. TS SDK sends `stopSequences: []` for same call. Minimal logs:
```
# python client
{"stop_sequences": null, "max_tokens": 64}

# ts client
{"stopSequences": [], "maxTokens": 64}
```

maria: ah yeah — server expects omission for default behavior. Null vs empty array semantics differ. We should accept both.

ron: I can take the py-sdk fix (emit omit instead of null). Assigning to myself. Will open PR.

alex: I'll add server-side lenient unmarshalling to treat `null` same as missing for list fields and normalize snake/camel. Backwards compatible.

jamie: thanks. Also noticed `response_format` vs `responseFormat` mismatch for multi-format endpoints — caused a failing TS integration test. Alex, can you add a mapping table so both are accepted?

alex: yep. Plan: update request unmarshalling -> normalize keys (snake <-> camel), coerce `null` list -> treat as omitted, add unit tests. Will target a patch release.

sarah: CI caught a flake — `echo` defaulting flipped in py-sdk change last week. We should add an explicit test for default boolean flags.

ron: PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1289 opened with py-sdk serialization fix. cc @sarah for tests.

ci-bot: build passed on linux, failing on macOS due to snapshot mismatch.

maria: snapshot failure is just formatting of generated examples; I'll update snapshots in a follow-up.

jamie: Action items: ron (py-sdk emit omit), alex (server lenient parsing), sarah (add unit + integration tests), maria (snapshots). If no objections I'll merge the SDK fix once CI green and server patch is deployed to staging. :+1:

sarah: sounds good. Can we also add a small end-to-end test exercising both py/ts clients against a local staging container? avoids surprises.

alex: added to my todo. Will push a staging deploy after tests pass.

ron: merged the py change to branch, will re-run CI after alex deploys server patch. :shipit:

jamie: awesome — thanks y'all. If anything blocks please ping in #eng-platform. :wave:
